svg.text: BetLab / confidence endpoints with rational certificates
Fixed factors 1 + b*(D-m)/2. Bet b=1, alpha=1/4; conservative closed outer intervals [L,1].
24 differences equal 1/2. The reported lower endpoint understates the exact boundary by at most 1/32768.
2 A later reversal cannot erase earlier exclusions
Eight +1 then twelve -1. Current-prefix inversion weakens; the running intersection retains its lower bound.
D is +1 with probability 3/4, otherwise -1: conditional mean 1/2 at every node, eight rounds.
Both probabilities are 2187/16384 <= 1/4. All conditional wealth slacks are zero.
Closed outer intervals include every nonrejected mean. Rational brackets are not exact algebraic roots.
One fixed mu must upper-bound every conditional mean. Not a drifting mean or a causal effect estimate.
Developed sequences and a supplied finite law. No optimality, model-selection or two-sided coverage claim.
